ARUNACHAL PRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No.PSC-R(A)/15/2021:: Dated ltanagar, the 3ra February'2022,
ADVERTISEMENT
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission invites applications online
from the citizens of India, for filling up of 77 nos. of Post of Post Graduate Teacher (PGT)
Group 'B' (Gazetted), under the Department of Education Govt. ofArunachal Pradesh in the
Scale Pay Matrix Level - 8,Rs 47,600-1,51,100 and other allowances as applicable. Out of
77 Posts, 60 nos. of Post of PGTs are reserved for APST candidates, 2 nos. of posts are
reserved for APST PwD candidates and 15 nos. of Post are unreserved i.e., for open
competition. The vacancy position is subject to variation. Any additional vacancy/post
received from Education Department will be included only before the
Prelimina ry/Recruitmen t Test is held.
The last date/time for submission of aonlication is 11.03.2022( 1600 hours).
How to apply, eligibility, age limit method of Selection, Documents to be Uploaded,
Examination fee and details of posts, etc, Candidates may visit the Commission's
web site-www.appsc. gov.in
